What I do

Four services that take a site from raw data to something clients, regulators and investors can understand.

GIS and spatial analysis

Maps and analysis for site selection, land use, planning studies and research.

Remote sensing

Satellite and drone imagery turned into land cover, change detection and environmental insight.

3D visualization

Realistic models and renders of bridges, markets, buildings and urban spaces.

Planning and EIA support

Drafting support for environmental impact assessments and planning documents.

Maps for research

Clear, publication-ready maps and spatial analysis for dissertations and theses.

Client visuals

Presentation visuals for real estate and contractor projects that help win approvals.

Selected work

Infrastructure and planning projects I have contributed to.

Proposed Ikotun Bridge and Market

3D Visualist, contract, March 2026

Built detailed SketchUp models of two bridge design prototypes (a two-pillar and a three-overhead configuration), produced architectural renderings for design review, and created Twinmotion animations showing how the structure fits in and how traffic flows.

Third Mainland Bridge, Lagos

3D Visualist, remote, for CCECC, September 2023

Modelled the existing bridge in 3D, worked with the design team to plan rehabilitation works, and animated on-peak and off-peak traffic to show ongoing construction.

Urban Prime Consults

Graduate Trainee since January 2025, Geospatial Analyst since June 2026

GIS mapping for planning and development control, land use and land cover analysis in Google Earth Engine and R, drone data in GIS workflows, and EIA drafting.

Residents' perception of urban green spaces

B.Sc. thesis, Olabisi Onabanjo University

Research on how residents of Lagos perceive the ecosystem services of urban green spaces.

About

I'm Daniel Odumosu, an urban and regional planner and geospatial analyst. I started City Catalysts to bring planning, data and design together, so that cities get built on clear evidence and clear pictures.

My interests are spatial analysis, sustainable housing, environmental planning, transportation planning and urban design, and I advocate for the Sustainable Development Goals.
